results.evidence: In duplicateInsight, `if (redirectToInsight) { sceneLayoutLogic.findMounted()?.actions.setScenePanelOpen(false); router.actions.push(...) }` closes the scene panel before redirecting. The author admits the Info-tab side-panel case isn't closed, but the overlay panel state is what's set.
`lemonToast.success('Insight duplicated')` is still called, and `router.actions.push(urls.insightEdit(newInsight.short_id))` still runs right after the close.
`setScenePanelOpen(false)` is called unconditionally whenever redirectToInsight is set. There is no check for overlay versus docked presentation, so a docked wide-screen panel is closed too.

The navigation to the transfer page is unchanged and carries no short id. The patch instead has the transfer page fetch it via `api.get(`api/environments/${currentTeamId}/insights/${logicProps.resourceId}/`)` on mount, which is not the same as carrying the identifier along.

`sourceResourceUrl` returns `insightShortId ? urls.insightView(insightShortId as InsightShortId) : urls.savedInsights()`. The short id comes from `loadSourceInsightShortId`, which returns `insight.short_id`.
When `insightShortId` is null (not loaded, fetch failed, or no team), the code returns `urls.savedInsights()`, the insights list.

The Dashboard case still returns `urls.dashboard(resourceId)` and the Survey case still returns `urls.survey(resourceId)`. The loader returns null for non-Insight kinds, and no URL parameters are added.

The card gets `className="@container p-6"` and the illustration is wrapped in `<div className="hidden @md:block shrink-0">`. Below @md the illustration is hidden, so only the text and button remain in the narrow modal. Above @md it sits beside the text.

result:
I made all three changes, but none of it has been run, type-checked or tested. I didn't add a test.

- **Duplicate on narrow screens:** in `frontend/src/scenes/insights/insightLogic.tsx`, the duplicate action now closes the actions sidebar just before it navigates to the new copy. It does this through `sceneLayoutLogic.setScenePanelOpen(false)`. I only close the scene panel (`scenePanelOpenManual`). The panel can also count as open because the side panel is open on its Info tab, and I haven't closed that.
- **Transfer page Back link:** the link was built from the numeric insight ID, and insight pages only load by short ID.
  - `resourceTransferLogic.ts` now fetches the source insight's short ID when the page mounts and the resource is an insight.
  - `ResourceTransfer.tsx` builds the Back link from `urls.insightView(shortId)`, the same builder used elsewhere.
  - If the fetch hasn't returned yet or fails, Back goes to the saved insights list.
- **Narrow subscriptions modal:** in `SubscriptionOverviewComponents.tsx`, the featured empty-state card is now a Tailwind container-query container (`@container`). Its illustration only shows at `@md` and wider, so a narrow modal shows just the text and button. Cards without an illustration still show the icon, unchanged.

- **Hand-written types:** I edited the types for `resourceTransferLogic.ts` by hand, since that file doesn't use generated ones.
- **Raw API call:** the short-ID fetch uses a plain `api.get` call, not a generated API function.
